items.source_en:
I'm going to level with you, future supervisor. You have your work cut out for you. This site is resource-rich, but it's a nightmare to get around. You and your crew are going to have to do some serious leveling to make it safe. I took a bad fall on my first day here, I'd hate for any of you to do the same. Especially with laser cutters in hand.

Six Sisters is aware of the conditions here. I'm sure they'll give you time to clean the site up before you start digging. They really seem to care about our safety. Don't cut any corners with the prep work. You'll regret it in the long run.

Be safe out here. I'll keep my fingers crossed for you. 

Elliot

items.legacy_ko:
솔직히 말씀드리죠, 미래의 감독관님. 여기 일은 절대 만만치 않을 겁니다. 자원은 풍부하지만, 돌아다니는 것 자체가 고역이에요. 안전하게 작업하려면 제대로 준비를 해야 할 겁니다. 저도 첫날 여기서 크게 넘어졌었는데, 여러분 중 누구도 저처럼 다치는 걸 바라지 않습니다. 특히 레이저 절단기를 들고 있다면 더욱 조심해야죠.

몸조심하시고, 행운을 빕니다.
